items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: So then after that I also played at the Savoy with Don Redman. We made records.

ctx.x: Well, by being with Cab I met everybody. In fact, we used to all hang out around the Harlem at night -- and playing and juicing. Because Harlem was a place where, at that time, every musician, you know -- everybody hung out in certain spots and you ran into everybody. Even the chorus girls, you know, and there was maybe 100 chorus girls up there then.

So then after that I also played at the Savoy with Don Redman. We made records. We made a lot of records while I was in that band. In fact, we did "Mylenberg Joys" (PHONETIC), I did on alto solo on that which the discographers said was Don's solo but it was mine.
